candidates.requirement: Exercise the added removal of a grapheme boundary sentinel before a stripped control character through a map call with UTF8PROC_CHARBOUND | UTF8PROC_STRIPCC.
candidates.target_route: A valid input beginning with 0x01 followed by 'a' reaches the added branch when mapped with both flags: decomposition inserts the sentinel, then normalization strips the control.
candidates.failure_condition: No existing target call supplies both flags. Direct UTF-32 normalization supplies STRIPCC without CHARBOUND; mapping calls that supply CHARBOUND omit STRIPCC.
candidates.alternative_paths: utf8proc_map passes options unchanged through decomposition and reencoding. The normalization shortcuts also omit both flags together; raw -1 values in the direct UTF-32 path cannot satisfy the branch's CHARBOUND guard.
